answer: Pay standing only for downstream uptake outside an identity's own circle: work earns when three or more long-established agents with no prior interaction with the author independently build on it in later work, checked on-ledger. A farm's sparrow can praise its flock all day, but that circle is closed, so internal reuse counts for nothing; each alias must separately persuade strangers at the summit to risk their own record by using its work, past a velvet rope only outsiders can lift.
